newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Gulf ratings, raises outlook.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Gulf ratings, raises outlook.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service Ltd said on Monday it confirmed Gulf Canada Resources Ltd's debt ratings and raised the trend outlook on the securities to positive from stable.
DBRS said Gulf Canada's debentures and senior notes were confirmed at BB (high), its senior subordinated debentures at B (high) and its series 1 & 2 preference shares at pfd-5.
It said the outlook was improved for several reasons including:

- Gulf Canada's acquisition of Britain's Clyde Petroleum Plc, which will add 41,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day to production, 130 million BOE to reserves, C$250 million of annualized cash flow and diversification of it operations;
- the company's Corridor Block gas project in Indonesia, scheduled to come on stream in late 1999, and another large gas field in the country to begin producing by 2000; and
- Gulf Canada's payment of dividend arrears, which currently stand at about C$43 million, is being made on a discretionary basis at the rate of C$1.2 million a month, DBRS said.
